LDH.Title: LD Hydez
LDH.Settings.Config.Name: Hide Hotbar Buttons
LDH.Settings.Config.Label: Configure Hidden Buttons
LDH.Settings.Config.Hint: Select which hotbar buttons to hide from players.
LDH.Config.GlobalNotes: These settings apply to all players unless overridden by player-specific settings.
LDH.Config.PlayerNotes: These settings override the global configuration for this player.
LDH.Config.SidebarPlayerNotes: Select which sidebar tabs to hide for this player.
LDH.Config.Pages.PlayerNotes: Hide entire hotbar pages for this player.
LDH.Config.NoPlayers: No player-specific configuration is available because there are no non-GM users in this world.
LDH.Settings.HideBackground.Name: Hide Hotbar Background
LDH.Settings.HideBackground.Hint: Removes the black background and box shadow.
LDH.Settings.ApplyToGM.Name: Apply to GM
LDH.Settings.ApplyToGM.Hint: If enabled, the hidden slots will also be hidden for the GM (useful for testing).
LDH.Settings.HideLeftControls.Name: Hide Left Controls
LDH.Settings.HideLeftControls.Hint: Hides the directory controls (e.g., macro directory, sound) on the left side of the hotbar.
LDH.Settings.HideRightControls.Name: Hide Right Controls
LDH.Settings.HideRightControls.Hint: Hides the page controls (arrows, lock) on the right side of the hotbar.
LDH.Config.Title: Hide Hotbar Buttons Configuration
LDH.Config.Notes: Select the hotbar slots you want to HIDE from players.
LDH.Config.General.HideBackgroundHint: Removes the background and box shadow from the hotbar.
LDH.Config.General.ApplyToGMHint: If enabled, settings will also affect the GM view (useful for testing).
LDH.Config.General.HideLeftControlsHint: Hides the directory controls (macro directory, sound) on the left side.
LDH.Config.General.HideRightControlsHint: Hides the page controls (arrows, lock) on the right side.
LDH.Config.General.HideSceneControlsHint: Hide the left-side scene controls toolbar.
LDH.Config.General.HideSceneNavigationHi: Hide the top scene navigation bar.
LDH.Config.General.HideMacroDirectoryHin: Hide the macro directory tab and control.
LDH.Config.General.OpacityHint: Set transparency level for visible hotbar slots (100% = fully visible).
LDH.Config.General.AnimationDurationHint: How long animations take when hiding/showing elements (0 = instant).
LDH.Config.Slots.Notes: Select individual hotbar slots to hide from players.
LDH.Config.Pages.Notes: Hide entire hotbar pages at once (10 slots per page).
LDH.Config.Presets.Notes: Save and load preset configurations for different scenarios.
LDH.Config.Advanced.Notes: Import, export, and share your configurations.
LDH.Config.Advanced.ExportHint: Download your current settings as a JSON file.
LDH.Config.Advanced.ImportHint: Load settings from a previously exported JSON file.
LDH.Config.Advanced.ShareHint: Generate a code to share your configuration with others.
LDH.Config.Advanced.LoadSharedHint: Load a configuration from a share code.
LDH.Notify.ImportFailed: Unable to import the configuration file.
LDH.Dialog.DeletePresetContent: Are you sure you want to delete preset "{name}"?
